# Glossary

Plain word meanings for the sample notes. Each entry is short on purpose. Where a term matters to the build, the entry points to the note that uses it, for example [[Test Stand Plan]].

## Separatrix

The separatrix is the boundary between field lines that close inside the plasma and field lines that leave it. In these notes it is used only as an example term for the search test, and the ratio named after it is defined in the physics notes, not here.

## Beta

Beta is the ratio of plasma pressure to magnetic pressure. A high beta means the field is used efficiently. The sample notes mention it only in passing.

## Cryostat

A cryostat is a vessel that keeps its contents cold, here at about four kelvin. The one we are buying is chosen in the shortlist note. A bath cryostat uses liquid helium; a pulse tube cryostat uses a compressor and no liquid.

## Gate

A gate is a check that a piece of work must pass before it counts as done. In the harness each gate is a command that exits zero on pass and one on fail and prints one line that says why.

## Wikilink

A wikilink is a link written as two square brackets around a note name. The sync program turns each one into a graph edge from the section that holds it to the note it names.
